entities.summary: Sergei Peretyagin is a Russian professional ice hockey defenceman who is currently playing for Kunlun Red Star of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He is in his second stint with the Red Star, having played in their inaugural season in the KHL in 2016–17 before briefly joining HC Ugra.
